navigator.title: College Navigator - University of Massachusetts-Dartmouth (fall 2024 enrollment, 2024-25 cost)

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: CDS 2024-2025 (fall 2024 entering class), C1: exact counts; the residency columns also include 3 applicants of unknown residency. International admit rate 687 of 761. Only 10% of enrollees submitted SAT and 1% ACT (C9), so the percentiles come from a small group. The GPA distribution and the C7 importance checkboxes were not machine-readable, so they are omitted. The 2025-2026 CDS was not found as a file (the university's archive page stops at 2024-25); this is the latest readable year.

cost.notes: College Navigator (IPEDS 2024-25): tuition figures include required fees; room and board and other expenses are on-campus. International students are charged the out-of-state rate (the CDS also mentions a NEBHE regional rate for some New England states). The international admissions page asks for proof of funds of at least $54,000.
